title: ASAPbio November Community Call: Informing DORA’s “Practical Guide for Scholarly Communication”
what_changed: DORA, ASAPbio and openRxiv co-hosted a community call (5 November) previewing DORA's forthcoming "Practical Guide to Implementing Responsible Research Assessment in Scholarly Communication" and asking the community to help shape it. openRxiv presented trust-signal features (open reviews, data and code availability) that preprint servers can offer for responsible assessment.
why_it_matters: The Guide follows DORA's 2025 research-organisation and 2026 funder guides and targets publishers, repositories, libraries and infrastructure providers; community input at this stage decides how practical it becomes, and preprint platforms are the live testing ground for assessment features.
